Parisa Kaprealian on Instagram: "Nowruz, the Persian New Year, has been celebrated for over 3,000 years - rooted in the ancient traditions of Persia and marking the arrival of spring and renewal.

It predates many religions and has been carried through generations as a cultural celebration. Today, it is embraced by people of many faiths and cultures - each honoring it in their own way.

For us, it is a moment to gather, to create beauty, and to stay connected to our heritage. A way to honor where we come from, and to pass those traditions on with love.

This year’s Haft-Seen was designed with intention - its vibrant palette inspired by Iranian architecture, art history and our traditional aesthetics, honoring the richness of our history and the beauty of a culture I carry with pride.

Haft-Seen literally means ‘Seven S’s.’

Iranian’s set a traditional Haft-Seen setting for Nowruz where we place seven symbolic items - each starting with the Persian letter ‘S’ (called ‘Seen’) - to represent different hopes for the new year, like health, love, and renewal.

Sabzeh (sprouts): rebirth, renewal, and growth

Samanu (sweet wheat pudding): abundance and strength

Senjed (dried oleaster fruit): love and wisdom

Seer (garlic): health and protection

Seeb (apple): beauty and good health

Somāq (sumac): sunrise, patience, and the triumph of light over darkness

Serkeh (vinegar): aging, wisdom, and acceptance

💚🤍♥️,
Parisa 

#haftseen #persiannewyear #norooz #nowruz #prettypleasedesign"
